lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Numerous high-intensity circular clusters are visible posterior to the branchial region, arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern following longitudinal axes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice-like arrangement of nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark vertical linear feature is present posterior to the fifth gill slit. A remora is attached to the lateral flank ventral to the primary carinal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent caustic light patterns caused by surface water refraction are superimposed over the dorsal and lateral surfaces, creating a high-contrast network of light bands.
